function_declarations.name: premortem
function_declarations.description: The DVE/GVE prosthetic premortem reflex — before writing, changing, debugging, or deploying code, briefly imagine how the decision could fail and turn that into an ARTIFACT (predicted failure modes → cheapest guard → predicted-vs-actual ledger), not just talk. Use before any risky change or deploy, or when the user says "premortem", "how could this fail", "what's the risk", "/premortem", "/dve". The operational core of the DVE Guidebook tool.

decision.description: one line: the decision being made (e.g. 'Deploy X to the live gateway')

phase.description: lifecycle phase the decision sits in (default: implementation)

failure.description: a predicted failure mode; repeatable, one ledger row each

rows.description: empty rows to leave when no --failure is given (default: 4)

out.description: ledger file appended to with --apply (default: notes/premortem.md)

apply.description: append the block to --out (default: print only)

json.description: emit the block as JSON instead of markdown
